commonProcedure:
WARD5-COMMON-149. This is static authored operational review of these five identities only. Preserve the complete native catalog record, original questions, school placements, class rows and historical metadata beside the new procedure. An Instantaneous source field remains in that evidence; a finite maintained ward lifetime below is an expressly NEW resolution, not recovered canon. No extra school access, generic upcast, class acquisition, feat, sourceStatus migration or canonical catalog/index write follows.

All five keep Action, V/S/F, native rank 8, base 21 RP and minimum class level 15. Use the actual casting class's ability, repertoire/preparation, school and additional costs: Cleric and Druid use Wisdom; Mage and Wizard use Intelligence, subject only to an actual sourced substitution. Spell attacks are d20 + PB + that modifier, and spell DC is 8 + PB + that modifier plus only genuinely acquired applicable source bonuses. None of these five admissions adds a save merely to use that DC. Antilife Shell has Cleric/Druid/Wizard routes only; the other four also have Mage. Perceive the recipient or chosen center, meet the native range and caster line of effect, have a usable somatic hand and actual focus, and be able to perform verbal components. A known absent legal target, inaccessible mode or unavailable action fails before payment. Private eligibility resolves after legal commitment, without a free diagnosis or refund. No save is added to these five NEW admission procedures. Recipient wards require actual willingness; an unconscious creature cannot newly consent. Previously established protection does not require continued consciousness.

Use the bound ordinary casting contract: determine final price from pre-cast Dissonance, then commit costs, Action, components and any concentration transition; update the actual class's first-family/base Dissonance and same-name Refrain exactly once at beginning; open legal cast-time counters; surviving payload resolves afterward. A countered or suppressed paid cast retains costs, cadence and displaced concentration. Readying pays/starts concentration at preparation and releases through the actual Reaction/trigger before its original deadline, without a second payment, cast or counter window. A required concentration spell uses the one real slot and ends on actual loss, incapacitation or source death. No ward receives a free extra action, start, recovery, rest, resource pool or hard-control allowance.

Each application has a unique cast/application ID, original source character/class/school/rank, recipient or fixed center, creation timestamp, original deadline, concentration owner if any, and actual suppression and termination causes. Half-open lifetimes [establishment,deadline): expiry wins at the deadline. Clocks continue through suppression, absence, reorder and scene transitions. Explicit elapsed-second lifetimes below override generic round conversion. Recasts are real new paid casts. For each recipient-ward identity, NEW at most one established application per recipient across casters/modes: a genuinely established eligible replacement ends the previous same-identity ward; a failed/countered/suppressed-before-establishment cast replaces nothing. Ordinary concentration displacement is independent. Separate fixed area casts have independent original identities; no stacked force, damage or clock reset. There is no new voluntary area dismissal permission; ending concentration where required follows the accepted interface. NEW a willing recipient may end its own Alignment Immunity or Mind Blank without an Action during its actual regular turn; it cannot waive one protected component while retaining the same ward. Ended wards do not restart without a new cast.

Newly prevented components create no dormant application, owed damage or guard claim. Suppression of a previously established eligible expression preserves its source record, original clock, used control guard, spent costs/actions and original damage roots. Resume only a still-live expression, with then-current lawful prerequisites and no missed ticks, commands, saves, healing, temporary-HP refill or repeated initial consequence. Existing consequences are not retroactively undone; a currently resumed Incapacitated component does end any genuinely new incompatible concentration, without refunding or repeating historical losses. Source ending while suppressed remains terminal. Actual positive damage, CON concentration saves and source-sensitive endings still use their own rules. These ward entry rules are not whole-Action denial and spend no hard-control guard.

Keep public observation separate from director-only predicates. A stopped body or unavailable information can be observed normally; no exact hidden alignment, score, membership, immunity cause, creature type or remote location is automatically published. Unresolved authoritative facts are explicit whole-case/branch holds, never fabricated successful campaign examples. A hidden fact that an actual authoritative campaign ledger possesses can be resolved privately; an auditor lacking that ledger cannot certify its positive case. Current index/receipts supersede old preparation labels calling already-applied cohorts pending; preserve those labels as historical evidence only. All inherited source/content/access/physical/cosmology/runtime holds remain; no whole-domain, runtime, human-play, balance or release approval is made.
procedure:
RW149-F. Preserve separate native school placements, not a benefit union. NEW select by actual acquired class school: Abjuration is a fixed 20-foot-RADIUS sphere centered at a perceived point within 20 feet; Universal retains its explicit fixed 10-foot-radius sphere and center within 10 feet. The ambiguous Abjuration '20-ft sphere' is expressly resolved as radius, not asserted to have printed that word. Every current class route is Abjuration; Universal has no current access grant and its use stays unavailable/held. Both use caster line of effect to center and a volume clipped by actual solid total cover from center. NEW concentration, maximum 60 elapsed seconds; this supplies a finite field rather than treating Instantaneous as permanence. No following aura, physical cover, pressure or rank ceiling.

NEW expressly adopt the Lesser local-expression domain for THIS identity: actual spells and explicitly magical nonspell/item expressions are suppressed at their real manifestation body/anchor/area, not every supernatural-sounding noun. A creature-attached spell expression is wholly suppressed while any part of its body intersects operative volume; an extended area loses only intersecting portions unless its exact source is indivisible. A magic item retains its mundane body, ownership, actual contents and physical custody while magical access/enhancements/actions are unavailable. Already completed damage, healing, injuries, ordinary permanent material changes, knowledge, prior movement and consumed resources persist. An ongoing magical form or animation follows its exact accepted body/gear/resumption contract; missing profiles are held rather than inventing reversion/deletion. A temporary-HP expression that is actually magical becomes unavailable only under its real suppression rules; its remaining pool, grant history and original deadline never refill. Ordinary RP, Dissonance engines and intrinsic nonmagical traits are not erased. Oracle's intrinsic Curse engine and Wizard Spell Preservation's primary-book protection remain protected exceptions; suppressed magical book use creates no ordinary destruction loophole.

NEW RW149-F-PAIR is limited to this Antimagic Field identity's two school modes and accepted Antimagic Field (Lesser). Their suppression-field expressions and required maintenance connection do not suppress one another or themselves; independently active volumes combine for payload checks. This expressly extends the Lesser same-family rule only to this pair, without rewriting Lesser's behavior against any other source. No rank-based winner, recursion or iteration-dependent oscillation. A second actual qualified caster can establish its field inside the first after full payment/components/concentration/cadence and cast-time counter opportunity. The field payload is exempt; unrelated spells by that caster are not. Losing either source's concentration/clock ends only that source. The exemption is not double concentration or immunity for dispel payloads.

NEW explicitly adopt AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for this identity. Legal casts inside still commit; an originating-inside ordinary magical payload is suppressed, without a queued future release. An outside-origin instantaneous payload checks its actual local recipient/area/destination; damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider. Indivisible teleport/placement with an inside destination footprint fails atomically at origin after cost, while outside-to-outside nonpath travel ignores an imaginary line through the sphere. Genuine projectile paths retain the source's actual semantics. A concentrating caster entering does not remotely suppress an outside effect. Ready/delayed release is checked at its actual manifestation time, retains preparation costs/original timer and grants no second cast or banked suppressed release.

Removal operations are not exempt ordinary spell payloads. Capture a legal dispel's immutable source-specific effect set, then capture suppression of EACH termination operation before any removal. An operation targeting a field ignores only that SAME field's suppression; a different field may still suppress the operation at its actual locus/origin. NEW for this Rank8 field alone, its fixed creation center is its discrete whole-application termination locus. A source-qualified area dispel can still capture an exposed portion under its original selection rule; suppression of this field's indivisible ending checks its fixed center and the real dispeller origin, ignoring only the target field. Partial overlap away from both points does not protect this field from termination. This does not redefine another spell's locus or capture scope. Resolve only nonsuppressed captured operations, with their real rank/cost/check; never rescan after an earlier removal. Wizard Arch Dispel Magic is its actual rank 3, Action, 3 RP, range 60, recharge 2, INT+PB versus 10+target rank above rank 3; it is not Greater Dispel. An acquired ordinary Greater Dispel is rank 5/base10/range30/30-foot area with rank6–9 checks versus10+2rank, only where actual access/preparation and accepted authority are proved. Counterspell is cast-time only and cannot terminate an already existing field. Arcane Sight or another genuinely operating perception source must supply actual effect perception; a suppressed sense does not conveniently see its own target. Capture set/suppression before changes in field order. Simultaneous outer deadlines use their recorded ordering, not a new removal scan.

NEW explicit five-profile extension of the already accepted AC5/AC6 same-body suppression lifecycles to THIS field: Greater Fire Pet, Faction Champion, Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally and each Faction Army soldier retain their same IDs, HP, current positions, Null state, true cargo/custody and original source deadlines. Full body intersection suppresses source-provided Speed/actions/attacks/commands/traits; independently genuine cargo remains and drops only if actual custody fails. Greater Air Pet's suppressed fly/hover permits genuine Falling. Source ending while suppressed still ends that source; resumption never resummons/heals/refills or replays commands. This is an explicit named bridge, not a universal summon rule. Other actually accepted profiles use their own supplied contracts only when their predicates authorize it; source-packet comparison labels alone grant nothing.

For ordinary Banishment and the two expressly bridged AC5 exiles Banish Elemental/Elemental Banishment, NEW this field invokes their existing close-on-actual-application-suppression lifecycle, preserving origin anchors, IDs, surviving cargo and mandatory terminal placement. The field must actually reach the application locus; the distant caster's presence does not project suppression into a cell. No new planes, endpoint topology, generic banishment of summons, resurrection, duplicated body or blanket terminal bypass is authored. Missing source/physical/cosmology facts remain whole-case or branch holds.
